repair_progression: 25/28 after typed source-set composition, subject intersection/union, difference/complement, quantification, and action-state predicate evaluation
28/28 after general remaining-set query detection and residual-only scope handling

held_out.general_repair: Interrogative report predicates are classified as read-only action-state queries before completion-report extraction, preventing a question from mutating every member of a resolved group.

mechanisms: B_CORE_ACTION_SET_QUERY_IR_1 represents the resolved action group as a typed source set and records selected, excluded, and unresolved members separately.
Intersection, union, difference, complement, all, any, and none are evaluated over ledger-bound action IDs rather than raw sentence dispatch.

The original query surface supplies grammatical operators while the independently resolved semantic surface supplies discourse bindings, preventing inserted member summaries from masquerading as user selectors.
Action predicates distinguish active plans, language-reported outcomes, and host-verified execution states.
Empty or unknown selections produce explicit ambiguity and no target action IDs.
Quantified answers add a claim-level ACTION_SET_EVALUATION record bound to the query hash and member ledger evidence.
Interrogative report predicates are read-only and cannot create completion reports or mutate the action ledger.
residual_limits: This remains bounded deterministic language engineering and does not establish GPT-level open-domain language competence.
Action-set expressions are flat; arbitrary parentheses, nested relative clauses, mixed operator precedence, and relational subqueries are not yet represented.
Subject matching remains grounded in the bounded action ledger and controlled Korean/English surface analysis.
The predicate catalog covers action plan, report, and verified execution states but not arbitrary domain properties.
Discourse group membership revision, nested composite groups, unrestricted ellipsis, and open-domain pragmatic inference remain open.
Natural realization remains less varied than a generative language model even though its quantified claims are evidence-bound.
next_program_order: nested and mixed-precedence grammatical composition over typed action and proposition expressions
explicit discourse-group membership addition removal and composite-group identity
topic suspension restoration with nested sets and broader deixis or ellipsis
compositional speech-intent and pragmatic inference with ambiguity preservation
request report observation and verified-result provenance across complex clauses
more natural evidence-grounded realization with claim-level support checks
